assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Not to scale: hunter B_n and rabbit A_n at distance d on line l; two dashed rabbit paths from A_n to Y_+ and Y_- symmetric about l, with the two possible rabbit positions after some steps sharing one report point on l; the hunter's later position H below l is joined to Y_+ by a dotted segment.

difficulty_rationale: IMO 2017 Problem 3. The decisive idea (two symmetric rabbit paths that produce identical tracking reports, so that the squared distance grows by a fixed amount in every block of rounds) is deeply hidden; the problem is beyond the usual AIME-oriented range and is placed at the top of the scale used for the bank.
